headlines.title: 8月新增信贷与社融预计环比回升 但低于去年同期
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月10日讯，近日对14家境内外机构的调查显示，受访经济学家对2026年8月新增人民币贷款的预测均值约为3820亿元，预计较2025年同期少增2080亿元，但环比7月的-3400亿元将明显好转；预测区间为100亿元至6000亿元。8月仍然是信贷投放的季节性“小月”，并且多数受访机构认为2026年8月新增人民币信贷规模不会超过去年同期。中金公司宏观研究报告指出，尽管相关部门对票据转贴现业务监管加强，8月票据利率仍然在地位徘徊、月末未见抬升，显示贷款需求偏弱背景下，银行直贴票据冲刺贷款指标的诉求仍然较强，因而判断8月信贷仍然弱于去年同期。中金公司预计

headlines.title_en: New credit and aggregate social financing in August are expected to rebound month-on-month, but remain below the same period last year
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 10 — A recent survey of 14 domestic and overseas institutions shows that the average forecast by surveyed economists for new RMB loans in August 2026 is about 382 billion yuan, expected to be 208 billion yuan less than the same period in 2025, but a clear improvement from -340 billion yuan in July; the forecast range is 10 billion yuan to 600 billion yuan. August is still a seasonal "small month" for credit extension, and most surveyed institutions believe that the scale of new RMB credit in August 2026 will not exceed the same period last year. A CICC macroeconomic research report pointed out that although relevant authorities strengthened supervision of bill rediscounting business, bill rates still hovered at low levels in August and did not rise at month-end, indicating that against the backdrop of weak loan demand, banks still have a strong desire to use direct bill discounting to meet loan targets, and therefore judges that August credit is still weaker than the same period last year. headlines.title: 国家发展改革委举行与美在华企业高层圆桌会
headlines.summary: 今天（9月10日）上午，国家发展改革委与美在华跨国企业高层圆桌会在京举办，主题为“拥抱‘十五五’ 共谋新发展”。亚马逊云、英伟达、戴尔、霍尼韦尔（中国）有限公司等60余家来自科技算力、工业能源和消费医药等领域美在华企业代表参会。会上，国家发展改革委相关司局介绍“十五五”规划纲要有关政策考虑，“十五五”时期我国利用外资政策情况，新一轮大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新政策有关实施成效，提振消费相关政策精神，相关负责人介绍发展北京市经济社会发展情况并推介北京市投资环境，跨国企业高层代表发言交流。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: The National Development and Reform Commission held a high-level roundtable with U.S. companies in China
headlines.summary_en: This morning (September 10), the National Development and Reform Commission and the Roundtable for Senior Executives of U.S. Multinational Enterprises in China was held in Beijing, with the theme "Embracing the '15th Five-Year Plan' and Seeking New Development Together." More than 60 representatives of U.S. companies in China, including Amazon Cloud, Nvidia, Dell, and Honeywell (China) Co., Ltd., from fields such as technology and computing power, industrial energy, and consumer and pharmaceuticals, attended the meeting. At the meeting, relevant departments and bureaus of the National Development and Reform Commission introduced policy considerations related to the outline of the "15th Five-Year Plan," the situation of China's foreign investment utilization policies during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the implementation results of the new round of large-scale equipment upgrading and consumer goods trade-in policies, and the spirit of policies related to boosting consumption. Relevant officials introduced Beijing's economic and social development situation and promoted Beijing's investment environment, and senior representatives of multinational enterprises spoke and exchanged views. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stocks midday review: the Hang Seng Index closed down 1.29%, with application software stocks and other sectors that were strong yesterday pulling back
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 10 — Overnight, the three major U.S. stock indices fluctuated and closed slightly lower, while the Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index fell sharply. After several consecutive days of declines, Hong Kong stocks opened sharply lower again this morning, with the Hang Seng Index opening down 289 points at 24,985, immediately losing the 25,000 mark and the 100-day line, then rapidly expanding losses to as much as 385 points to a low of 24,889. As of the midday close, the Hang Seng Index fell 1.29% in the morning session, the Tech Index fell 2.07% in the morning session, and total market turnover of the Hang Seng Index was HK$105.86 billion. On the board, application software, power equipment, heavy machinery, and semiconductor equipment stocks fluctuated and pulled back, pharmaceuticals and pork were weak, and autos, tea drinks, and online retail fell for several consecutive days; printing and packaging and storage concepts led the market higher, while port shipping, Chinese banks, and Chinese brokerage stocks fluctuated upward. headlines.title_en: A leading A-share company has entered the supply chain for Apple's first foldable-screen phone, the iPhone Duo
headlines.summary_en: According to people in the industry chain, Lingyi iTech is a supplier for Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. The company supplies Apple with core precision components related to a new-generation terminal product, covering hinge precision structural parts, screen support plates, ultra-thin vapor chambers, and other products, with the per-unit value of supplied products higher than that for bar phones. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title_en: Universities buying homes for dormitories takes effect: freshmen live in garden-style houses for CNY 1,500 per year
headlines.summary_en: [Universities buying homes as dormitories implemented: freshmen live in garden-style houses for 1,500 yuan per year] The fall semester has already begun, and student dormitories converted from purchased existing real estate by multiple universities have officially opened. A review by reporters found that China University of Mining and Technology (Xuzhou), Xuzhou Medical University, Hefei University of Technology, and other universities all purchased existing real estate as student apartments in 2025, and this year's freshmen have already moved in.

headlines.title: 2026年侵权假冒伪劣商品全国统一销毁行动今日开展，覆盖200多个品种
headlines.summary: 今天（10日），国家质量强国建设协调推进领导小组办公室、市场监管总局联合组织开展2026年侵权假冒伪劣商品全国统一销毁行动，全国25个省（区、市）同步开展侵权假冒伪劣商品销毁工作。据了解，近年来，各地区、各有关部门聚焦社会关注、民生关切，持续深化重点领域、重点产品、重点环节治理，不断加大保护知识产权和打击侵权假冒工作力度，连续组织开展侵权假冒伪劣商品统一销毁行动，有力保护了消费者和权利人合法权益，在助力质量强国和知识产权强国建设、营造市场化法治化国际化一流营商环境等方面发挥了积极作用。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: 2026 national unified destruction campaign for infringing, counterfeit and shoddy goods launched today, covering more than 200 product categories
headlines.summary_en: Today (the 10th), the Office of the Leading Group for Coordinating the Building of a Quality Power and the State Administration for Market Regulation jointly organized the 2026 nationwide unified destruction action for infringing, counterfeit, and shoddy goods, with 25 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) across the country simultaneously carrying out the destruction of infringing, counterfeit, and shoddy goods. It is understood that in recent years, all regions and relevant departments have focused on social concerns and livelihood issues, continuously deepened governance in key areas, key products, and key links, steadily increased efforts to protect intellectual property and combat infringement and counterfeiting, and continuously organized unified destruction actions for infringing, counterfeit, and shoddy goods, effectively protecting the lawful rights and interests of consumers and rights holders, and playing a positive role in helping build a quality power and an intellectual property power and in creating a market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized first-class business environment. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock market midday review: Hang Seng Index falls 1.29%, Hang Seng Tech Index falls 2.07%
headlines.summary_en: At the Hong Kong stock market midday close, the Hang Seng Index fell 1.29%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.07%. Hang Seng Index Hong Kong Stock Connect ETF Yinhua (159318) fell 1.0%, and Hong Kong Stock Connect Tech ETF Penghua (159751) fell 1.63%. By sector, security and alarm services and building products III sectors were among the top gainers; computer and electronic product retail and machine tool sectors were among the top decliners. Among individual stocks, Mech-Mind Robotics rose 9.85%, Zhen Health Medical-B rose 8.81%, Haiguang Xinzheng rose 8.19%, Jiayao Holdings rose 7.65%, and Haiqing Zhiyuan rose 7.4%; Qunhe Technology fell 8.93%, CGN Mining fell 7.88%, Zhipu fell 7.88%, JITAI Technology-P fell 7.46%, and Everest Medicines fell 7.43%.

headlines.title: 特斯拉降价后有门店爆单，多个汽车品牌开启促销
headlines.summary: 特斯拉降价冲上热搜后，多家门店爆单了。“昨天（9月7日）早上政策一出来，订单消息就没断过。”9月8日，某特斯拉体验中心销售顾问告诉记者，Model Y长续航版是消费者最关注的车型，截至9月7日下午，其所在的门店已锁定20多个订单。9月7日，特斯拉中国宣布，即日起至9月30日（含）前下单并提车，Model 3全系现车现金激励5000元，Model Y全系现车现金激励1万元。这并非孤立事件。据记者不完全统计，截至目前已有超过十家车企在9月集中释放购车权益，覆盖新势力、自主、合资与豪华品牌。（每经网）

headlines.title_en: Some Tesla stores see order surge after price cuts, multiple auto brands launch promotions
headlines.summary_en: After Tesla's price cut trended on social media, multiple stores saw a surge in orders. "Yesterday (September 7) morning, as soon as the policy came out, order messages never stopped." On September 8, a sales consultant at a Tesla Experience Center told reporters that the Model Y Long Range version is the model consumers care about most, and as of the afternoon of September 7, the store where he works had locked in more than 20 orders. On September 7, Tesla China announced that for orders placed and vehicles delivered from now until September 30 (inclusive), the entire Model 3 lineup of in-stock vehicles would receive a 5,000 yuan cash incentive, and the entire Model Y lineup of in-stock vehicles would receive a 10,000 yuan cash incentive. This is not an isolated event. According to an incomplete tally by reporters, so far more than ten automakers have concentrated their release of car purchase benefits in September, covering new forces, independent brands, joint ventures, and luxury brands. (National Business Daily)
